verses.1: For destruction shall come upon the children of Korach.
verses.2: You have desired, O LORD, that your land be a place of rest for Jacob.
verses.3: You have carried the sins of your people; you have covered all their sins.
verses.4: You have gathered all your answers from the depths of your heart.
verses.5: May our God come to our aid, and may He settle your anger with us.
verses.6: The heavens will be filled with our children, generation after generation.
verses.7: May you not return to us, so that our people may rejoice in you.
verses.8: Let us see Your kindness and your salvation, which You will give us.
verses.9: I hear what the Lord God says. He speaks peace to His people and to His saints. May they not return to destruction.
verses.10: But those who are close to their Lord will be blessed in our land.
verses.11: True kindness and justice have been united; peace and harmony have been established.
verses.12: Truth will flourish from the earth, and righteousness will arise from heaven.
verses.13: And Jehovah will give us good, and our land will produce abundance.
verses.14: Justice shall go before him, and it will be established as a path for his actions.
